text: なにか　ちがうと　かんじたら　まず　Ａボタンです！

structure.jp: なにか　ちがうと　かんじたら
structure.en: if you feel something is different

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: ちがうと　かんじたら
patterns.explanation: と before a verb of thinking or feeling wraps up what is thought or felt, like 'that'. ちがうと　かんじたら = 'if you feel that it's different'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. かんじたら = 'if you feel'.
